description: Rules over what the board's watchers see: SWEEP's Bluetooth and Wi-Fi categories, Remote ID, drone links, aircraft, the pager decoder, P25, REC and the mesh. Raises a banner, chirp, vibration, speech, an SD log or a mesh share, keeps watching in the background, and reads the same /sdcard/detector/rules.json the built-in DETECTOR did. Needs firmware with SDK 2.2.
